31228.a:
**Swap** — RAM kengaytmasi emas, *bosim klapani*: kernel kam ishlatiladigan **anonymous** page'larni (heap, stack) diskka chiqaradi, RAM'ni page cache yoki aktiv jarayon uchun bo'shatadi.

- File-backed page (binary, mmap fayl) swap'ga tushmaydi — shunchaki tashlanadi, fayldan qayta o'qiladi.
- Turlari: swap partition, swap file, zram (siqilgan RAM).

```sh
swapon --show
free -h
```

31229.a:
```sh
fallocate -l 4G /swapfile      # btrfs/eski FS'da: dd if=/dev/zero ...
chmod 600 /swapfile            # boshqalar o'qimasin (xotira sirlari!)
mkswap /swapfile
swapon /swapfile
echo '/swapfile none swap sw 0 0' >> /etc/fstab
swapon --show
```
O'chirish: `swapoff /swapfile` (sahifalar RAM'ga qaytadi — RAM yetmasa OOM).

Btrfs'da swap file uchun NOCOW + bitta subvolume kerak.

31230.a:
| | Partition | File |
|---|---|---|
| Yaratish | partitsiyalash | `fallocate` |
| O'lcham | o'zgartirish qiyin | oson |
| Tezlik | ~bir xil (2.6+ kernel bloklarni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri map qiladi) | ~bir xil |
| Hibernate | oson | `resume_offset` kerak |

LVM ustida swap LV — ikkalasining o'rtasi.

31231.a:
`vm.swappiness` (0–200, default 60) — reclaim paytida anon page (swap) vs file page (cache) qaysi biri afzal.

- **0** — swap faqat oxirgi chora (OOM xavfi oshadi).
- **1–10** — DB (PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Kafka): heap swap'ga tushmasin.
- **60** — umumiy.
- **100+** — zram bilan (swap arzon).

```sh
sysctl vm.swappiness
sysctl -w vm.swappiness=10
echo 'vm.swappiness=10' > /etc/sysctl.d/99-swap.conf
```
Mif: swappiness=0 swap'ni o'chirmaydi.

31232.a:
```sh
free -h                           # Swap used
vmstat 1                          # si/so: sekundiga swap in/out
grep VmSwap /proc/*/status | sort -k2 -n | tail
smem -s swap -r | head
cat /proc/pressure/memory         # PSI: some/full stall %
```
**Muhim farq:** *swap used* katta, lekin `si/so ≈ 0` — muammo emas (eski, kerakmas page'lar). `si/so` doimiy yuqori — **thrashing**, latency o'sadi.

31233.a:
**Belgilar:**
- `vmstat 1`: `si`, `so` doimiy yuzlab/minglab; `wa` yuqori.
- `/proc/pressure/memory` `full avg10` > 10%.
- `sar -B`: `majflt/s` yuqori.
- SSH javob bermaydi, load average baland, CPU user past.

**Hal:** xotira iste'molchini topish (`smem`, `ps --sort -rss`), limit qo'yish (cgroup `memory.max`), RAM qo'shish. Oldini olish: `systemd-oomd`/`earlyoom` — thrashing o'rniga erta kill.

31234.a:
- **zram:** `/dev/zram0` — RAM'dagi siqilgan disk; `mkswap` + `swapon -p 100`. Fedora/Android default. Disk IO yo'q.
- **zswap:** kernel funksiyasi — disk swap'ga yozishdan oldin page'ni siqib RAM pool'da saqlaydi; pool to'lsa diskka.

**Qachon:** kam RAM'li VM/edge, laptop. Siqish ~2–3x. Trade-off — CPU.

Swap yo'q host'da ham zram yengil bufer beradi.

31235.a:
**Tarixiy sabab:** `memory.limit` + swap = pod limitdan oshsa ham OOM bo'lmay sekinlashadi; scheduler va eviction RAM'ga asoslangan; latency garantiyasi buziladi. Kubelet `--fail-swap-on=true` default.

**Hozir:** `NodeSwap` feature (1.28 beta, 1.30+ yaxshilangan), cgroup v2 talab:
- `swapBehavior: LimitedSwap` — faqat Burstable pod'lar, limitga proporsional.
- Guaranteed/BestEffort — swap yo'q.

**Amaliyot:** latency-sensitive workload'li node'da swap o'chiq, swap kerak bo'lsa alohida node pool.

31236.a:
**Swap'siz:** bosimda OOM killer DB'ni o'ldiradi (eng katta RSS) — keskin, lekin aniq.
**Katta swap:** DB heap swap'ga tushadi — p99 latency soniyalarga, "tirik, lekin o'lik" holat; health check o'tadi, foydalanuvchi kutadi.

**Odatdagi kompromiss:**
- 1–4 GB swap, `vm.swappiness=1..10`.
- DB buffer'ni RAM'ga mos o'lchash (`shared_buffers`, JVM `-Xmx`), huge pages.
- Elasticsearch: `bootstrap.memory_lock: true` (mlockall) yoki swap off.
- Alert: `si/so > 0` uzoq vaqt, PSI memory.

Principal fikr: swap — capacity muammosini yashiradi; asosiy yechim — to'g'ri sizing va limitlar.

31237.a:
**Disk quota** — kernel FS darajasida limit:
- **blocks** — hajm (KB).
- **inodes** — fayllar soni.

Kimga: **user**, **group**, **project** (katalog daraxti — XFS/ext4).

Misol: shared hosting, universitet server `/home`, CI runner'lar, multi-tenant NFS. Quota'siz bitta log loop butun `/` ni to'ldirib, butun tizimni yiqitadi.

31238.a:
- **Hard limit** — absolyut chegara, yozish `Disk quota exceeded` (EDQUOT).
- **Soft limit** — ogohlantirish chegarasi; oshgach **grace period** boshlanadi.
- Grace tugasa — soft limit hard'ga aylanadi, user tozalamaguncha yozolmaydi.

```sh
setquota -u ali 9G 10G 0 0 /home   # soft hard isoft ihard
setquota -t 604800 604800 /home    # grace (sek)
```

31239.a:
```sh
# /etc/fstab
UUID=... /home ext4 defaults,usrquota,grpquota 0 2
mount -o remount /home
quotacheck -cugm /home     # aquota.user/aquota.group
quotaon -v /home

setquota -u ali 9G 10G 100000 120000 /home
edquota -u ali             # interaktiv
quota -us ali              # user ko'radi
repquota -as               # hammasi
```
Zamonaviy ext4: `tune2fs -O quota` — journaled quota, `quotacheck` kerak emas.

31240.a:
```sh
# fstab: /data xfs defaults,uquota,pquota 0 0  (remount yetmaydi, umount/mount)
echo '42:/data/tenantA' >> /etc/projects
echo 'tenantA:42'       >> /etc/projid
xfs_quota -x -c 'project -s tenantA' /data
xfs_quota -x -c 'limit -p bhard=50g tenantA' /data
xfs_quota -x -c 'report -pbih' /data
```
**Project quota** — katalog bo'yicha: tenant/app papkasi. Docker overlay2 `--storage-opt size=` XFS pquota'ga tayanadi.

`/` root FS'da XFS quota — kernel cmdline `rootflags=uquota`.

31241.a:
| Usul | Nimani cheklaydi | Trade-off |
|---|---|---|
| User/group quota | user fayllari | uid umumiy bo'lsa ishlamaydi |
| Project quota (XFS/ext4) | katalog daraxti | FS-ga bog'liq |
| Alohida LV/PVC | butun volume | izolyatsiya yaxshi, bo'sh joy isrof |
| K8s `ephemeral-storage` | pod log + emptyDir + writable layer | limitda evict |
| cgroup io.max | IO tezligi, hajm emas | — |

**Gotcha:** quota 100% to'lishi ilovada `EDQUOT` xatosi — ENOSPC kabi ishlov berish kerak. Monitoring: limitga 80%da alert.
